messages.content:
Before implementing anything, FIRST scan all existing frontend components, services,
routes, signals, and UI flows to detect whether any part of the required logic already
exists. Reuse or extend existing components instead of duplicating logic.

────────────────────────────────────────
### GOAL — Add Kumon‑Style Progression UI
────────────────────────────────────────

Support new backend progression endpoints:

GET  /api/progression/:studentId/overview
POST /api/progression/:studentId/topics/:topicId/test
POST /api/progression/:studentId/topics/:topicId/tests/adhoc
POST /api/progression/:studentId/topics/:topicId/remediation
POST /api/progression/:studentId/topics/:topicId/advance

Integrate these into the existing worksheet, diagnostic, insights, and mastery UI.

────────────────────────────────────────
### REUSE EXISTING COMPONENTS
────────────────────────────────────────

Reuse and extend:

- insights-page.component
- topic-mastery.component
- mastery-progress.component
- detailed-topic-analysis.component
- worksheet-page.component
- diagnostic-page.component
- diagnostic-result-page.component
- worksheet-result-card.component

These already support:
- mastery display
- accuracy/speed display
- question flows
- results screens

────────────────────────────────────────
### NEW UI REQUIRED
────────────────────────────────────────

Add or extend:

1. TopicProgressPageComponent  
   Uses data from:
   GET /api/progression/:studentId/overview

   Shows:
   - worksheets completed
   - tests taken
   - tests passed
   - next test unlock threshold
   - mastery score
   - status (learning / ready_for_test / needs_remediation / mastered)

2. TestReadyBannerComponent  
3. RemediationBannerComponent  
4. AdvancementBannerComponent  

────────────────────────────────────────
### NEW SERVICE METHODS REQUIRED
────────────────────────────────────────

Extend LearningApiService with:

- getProgressOverview(studentId) → GET /api/progression/:studentId/overview
- createScheduledTest(topicId)
- createAdhocTest(topicId)
- createRemediationWorksheet(topicId)
- advanceTopic(topicId)

Reuse existing worksheet/test/diagnostic methods where possible.

────────────────────────────────────────
### NEW ROUTES REQUIRED
────────────────────────────────────────

Add:

- /progression/overview
- /progression/topic/:topicId/test
- /progression/topic/:topicId/remediation
- /progression/topic/:topicId/advance

Reuse existing routing patterns.

────────────────────────────────────────
### UI STATE MACHINE
────────────────────────────────────────

Add state handling for:

- learning
- ready_for_test
- needs_remediation
- mastered

Use existing signals/computed state from:

- practice-hub.component
- worksheet-page.component
- diagnostic-page.component

────────────────────────────────────────
### RESULTS SCREEN EXTENSION
────────────────────────────────────────

Extend worksheet results to show:

- test pass/fail
- next steps:
    - take test
    - remediation required
    - advance topic

────────────────────────────────────────
### FINAL OUTPUT REQUIRED
────────────────────────────────────────

Produce:

1. Updated components (extend existing)
2. New topic progress screen
3. Updated worksheet/test/remediation flows
4. Updated LearningApiService
5. Updated routing
6. Updated results screen
7. Updated state machine
8. All changes must reuse existing components where possible
